name: Peruíbe (Brazil)
description: Gyronny of blue and white, charged at the centre with a white disc outlined in black bearing the municipal arms.
history: Peruíbe is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 24 February 1966 (instituted by Municipal Law No. 238 of 24 February 1966 under Mayor Albano Ferreira, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: disc outlined in black bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown and a landscape
